name: heel v1
note: heel v1 (2026-10-13), for heel_v1_post.py / heel_v1_field.py, appended after P-ankle1. Anatomy review 2026-10-13 finding 7; Nick, 2026-10-13: "Yes, fix all ten of them." Written for the +x foot; the -x foot uses it mirrored on its own grid. corner: the heel's back-bottom corner taken back to an arc of radius .06 round (y 0, z -.90), tangent to the floor, pulled in with gain 5 so the old sole's edge lip at the heel goes too, and the heel stays on the floor plane (rounded, not lifted); sole: within .012 of the floor (z -.957) the sole rises .004 except under the pads (four toe pads, a three-lobed metatarsal pad, the heel's contact patch), faded out behind y 0 so only the corner arc shapes the heel back, so the pads are low mounds on the floor and the sole's edge lip rolls in; blurX: an across-the-foot blur over the heel's back and sides that merges the leg column's ridge and the grooves beside it (the small bumps on the heel's sides); blurs: a light blur over the sole (pad edges) one where the corner arc meets the floor, and one round the old sole slab's top edge at z -.944 (the edge lip's upper rim, which had left a bump in the heel's side silhouette); partBox: |x| from .18 (in by .20), z below -.85 (in by -.88). World units, +y back.
